definitions.name: Vicious Longbow
definitions.summary: On a critical hit, the target takes 7 extra damage of the weapon's type (the book says a natural 20; this table counts any critical hit).

definitions.name: Nature's Mantle
definitions.summary: Druid or ranger spellcasting focus. While in light obscurement you can Hide as a bonus action, even while observed.

modifiers.label: Nature's Mantle: in light obscurement you can Hide as a bonus action, even while observed.

actions.name: Hide (Nature's Mantle)
actions.note: While in an area that's lightly obscured: Hide as a bonus action, even if you're being observed.

definitions.name: Chime of Opening
definitions.summary: Strike it to open one lock or latch within 120 ft; limited charges.

charges.onEmpty: The last charge is gone: the chime cracks and is useless.

actions.name: Chime of Opening
actions.note: Point it at a door, lock, lid or similar within 120 ft and strike it: one lock or latch opens (silence stops it). Uses a charge: tap it on the item.

definitions.name: Adventuring gear
definitions.summary: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, torches, rations, waterskin, rope, quiver.

definitions.name: Shortbow of Warning
definitions.summary: While attuned: advantage on initiative, and you and nearby allies can't be surprised.

definitions.name: Flame Tongue Shortsword
definitions.summary: Bonus action to ignite: while lit it deals 2d6 extra fire damage and sheds light.

actions.name: Ignite Flame Tongue
actions.note: Flames add 2d6 fire to its hits. Speak the word again, or drop or sheathe it, to put it out.

definitions.name: Stone of Good Luck
definitions.summary: +1 to ability checks and saving throws.

definitions.name: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location
definitions.summary: Hidden from divination magic.

definitions.name: Goggles of Night
definitions.summary: Darkvision 60 ft, or +60 ft if you already have it.

definitions.name: Horn of Silent Alarm
definitions.summary: A blast only one chosen creature can hear.

actions.name: Horn of Silent Alarm
actions.note: A blast only one creature you choose within 600 ft can hear. Uses a charge: tap it on the item; 1d4 come back each dawn.

definitions.name: Other gear
definitions.summary: Something your background or the table gave you that has no entry of its own; it carries the name you see.

definitions.name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)
definitions.summary: One spell written in a magical cipher. If it's on your class's spell list, read it (the spell's casting time, no material components) to cast it; then the scroll crumbles. Save DC 13, attack +5.

definitions.name: Boots of Striding and Springing
definitions.summary: While you wear them, your walking speed is at least 30 ft (armor or carried weight don't slow you), and you jump three times as far, though no farther than your remaining movement.

definitions.name: Ring of Jumping
definitions.summary: While you wear it, you can cast jump on yourself at will as a bonus action.

spells.name: Jump
spells.casting: at will, on yourself, as a bonus action

text: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

use.note: Drinking it or giving it to another creature takes an action.

use.note: Drinking it or giving it to another creature takes an action.

definitions.name: Potion of Resistance

use.note: Drinking it or giving it to another creature takes an action.

use.note: Drinking it or giving it to another creature takes an action.

definitions.name: Potion of Longevity
definitions.summary: You grow 1d6 + 6 years younger (minimum 13). Each one you've drunk before gives a cumulative 10% chance of aging 9d6 years instead.

use.note: Drinking it takes an action. Roll its effect on your age with your DM.

definitions.name: Potion of Vitality

use.note: Drinking it or giving it to another creature takes an action.

definitions.name: Potion of Dragon's Majesty
definitions.summary: Become an adult dragon of the scale's kind (chromatic, gem or metallic) for 1 hour, keeping your languages, personality and memories.

use.note: Drinking it or giving it to another creature takes an action.

definitions.name: Demon Armor
definitions.summary: Plate armor, +1 AC. Your unarmed strikes with its clawed gauntlets are magic weapons: +1, 1d8 slashing. You understand and speak Abyssal.

when.text: against a demon's spells and special abilities

curse.text: Once you put it on you can't take it off until Remove Curse or similar magic is cast on you. While you wear it you have disadvantage on attack rolls against demons and on saving throws against their spells and special abilities.

definitions.name: Sword of Vengeance
definitions.summary: A +1 longsword haunted by a vengeful spirit.

when.text: with any weapon other than this sword

curse.text: You don't want to part with it: you keep it on you at all times, and you have disadvantage on attack rolls with any other weapon. Whenever another creature damages you while the sword is with you, make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw; on a failure you must attack that creature until it drops to 0 hit points or you can't reach it to make a melee attack. Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse.

definitions.name: Berserker Axe
definitions.summary: A +1 battleaxe; your hit point maximum goes up by 1 for each level you have.

when.text: with any weapon other than this axe, unless no foe you can see or hear is within 60 ft

curse.text: You don't want to part with it: you keep it within reach, and you have disadvantage on attack rolls with any other weapon unless no foe you can see or hear is within 60 ft. Whenever a hostile creature damages you while the axe is with you, make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw; on a failure you go berserk: each turn you attack the nearest creature (or move to reach one), until you start your turn with no creature within 60 ft that you can see or hear.

definitions.name: Shield of Missile Attraction
definitions.summary: A shield that gives resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks.

modifiers.label: Shield of Missile Attraction: resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks (halve it when you enter it).

curse.text: You don't want to part with it. Whenever a ranged weapon attack is made against a target within 10 ft of you, the curse makes you the target instead.

definitions.name: Armor of Vulnerability (Bludgeoning)
definitions.summary: Plate armor that gives resistance to bludgeoning damage.

curse.text: You can't take it off until Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse. While you wear it you're vulnerable to piercing and slashing damage.

definitions.name: Armor of Vulnerability (Piercing)
definitions.summary: Plate armor that gives resistance to piercing damage.

curse.text: You can't take it off until Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse. While you wear it you're vulnerable to bludgeoning and slashing damage.

definitions.name: Armor of Vulnerability (Slashing)
definitions.summary: Plate armor that gives resistance to slashing damage.

curse.text: You can't take it off until Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse. While you wear it you're vulnerable to bludgeoning and piercing damage.

definitions.name: Ring of Evasion

actions.name: Ring of Evasion
actions.note: A Dexterity save you failed becomes a success. Spend a charge: tap it on the ring.

definitions.name: Ring of Free Action
definitions.summary: Difficult terrain costs you no extra movement, and magic can't reduce your speed or make you paralyzed or restrained.

modifiers.label: Ring of Free Action: magic can't paralyze or restrain you, or reduce your speed

definitions.name: Ring of Spell Storing
definitions.summary: Holds up to 5 levels of spells cast into it; while you wear it you can cast them (the original caster's level, DC and attack).

actions.name: Ring of Spell Storing
actions.note: Cast a spell stored in it: its slot level, DC, attack bonus and ability are the original caster's. Write what it holds in the ring's notes.

definitions.name: Ring of Regeneration
definitions.summary: You regain 1d6 hit points every 10 minutes if you have at least 1; lost body parts grow back over 1d6 + 1 days.

actions.name: Ring of Regeneration: 10 minutes
actions.note: Every 10 minutes, if you have at least 1 hit point.

definitions.name: Boots of Speed
definitions.summary: Bonus action: click the heels to double your walking speed, and opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage. 10 minutes in all per long rest.

actions.name: Boots of Speed
actions.note: Speed doubled; opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage. Click again to stop. 10 minutes in all until a long rest.

definitions.name: Boots of Elvenkind
definitions.summary: Your steps make no sound: advantage on Stealth checks to move silently.

definitions.name: Boots of Levitation

spells.name: Levitate
spells.casting: at will, on yourself

definitions.name: Winged Boots
definitions.summary: Fly at your walking speed for up to 4 hours a day (in pieces of at least a minute); 2 hours back for every 12 hours unused.

actions.name: Winged Boots
actions.note: Flying speed equal to your walking speed. Up to 4 hours a day; you fall when they run out.

definitions.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
definitions.summary: Hood up: Perception checks to see you have disadvantage, and you have advantage on Stealth checks to hide.

definitions.name: Cloak of Displacement
definitions.summary: You seem to stand somewhere else: attacks against you have disadvantage until you're hit, then again from the start of your next turn.

actions.name: Cloak of Displacement
actions.note: Attacks against you have disadvantage. After you're hit it stops until the start of your next turn; it doesn't work while you're incapacitated, restrained or can't move.

definitions.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
definitions.summary: You stabilize at the start of your turn when dying, and you regain twice the hit points from Hit Dice.

modifiers.label: Periapt of Wound Closure: you stabilize at the start of your turn instead

actions.name: Staff of Power: Retributive Strike

when.text: a save against a spell or other magical effect

when.text: against a fiend or an undead
a save against a spell or other magical effect

actions.name: Javelin of Lightning: the bolt

roll.label: lightning damage to each creature in the 5-ft-wide line (DC 13 Dexterity save: half; the target takes it on a hit too)

actions.note: Speak its word as you throw it.

definitions.name: Mace of Disruption
